data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): config-loading pattern in reconcile.py — differ.py uses sys.modules.setdefault() (idempotent); reconcile.py's _load() helper uses sys.modules[name] = mod (unconditional overwrite, line 30). If task-3 adds config loading via _load(), it OVERWRITES any cached module pre-registered by a differ-first test path. Pin task-3 to use the same idempotent sys.modules.setdefault pattern differ.py uses, OR amend _load() to use setdefault for the config module specifically. Add a regression test: pre-register a mock dso_reconciler_config in sys.modules, invoke reconcile_once, assert the mock survives.
